correctness.rationale: For each coordinate-ordered cone, decompose centered normal u into nonnegative nested centered indicator rays with adjacent gaps. Each simplex width is linear in those gaps. Strict Euclidean triangle inequality, since distinct step rays are not positive collinear, excludes non-step minimizers. A b-leaf cut meets exactly 2^m-2^(m-b) hub tubes, and squared normalized width is [(2^m-2^(m-b))^2(m+1)]/[b(m+1-b)]. Reflect b>n/2 to smaller b; prove consecutive f_n(b) decreasing for b>=2 from the exact A_b,T_b inequalities. Comparing b=1 to balanced b=floor(n/2) yields unique 1-leaf minimizer m<=13, unique balanced minimizer m>=14. Exact rational checks independently verified all minimizing sizes through m=100, including n=14/15; finite confirmation supplements all-m proof.

originality.rationale: The exact Euclidean width and all minimizing normals of the fixed unit tube-simplex stellohedron are distinct from its Ehrhart polynomials, inball/circumball, asymmetry, principal-axis covariance and random-direction width distribution, despite identical underlying star graph. The sharp m=14 transition is not an algebraic consequence of those different extremal statistics. A more general min-width theorem phrased for generalized permutohedra remains an unexcluded bibliographic risk.
residual_risks: Only the exact unit-coefficient simplex sum and induced Euclidean affine metric are covered.
Other width literature on generalized permutohedra may imply a formula under different terminology.
